Name: Inventory While Fishing
Author: jevonlipsey
Description:
[b]Inventory While Fishing[/b] is a simple mod that makes multitasking possible by allowing you to open your main game menu without pausing the in-game clock.

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/0B5ALW2.gif[/img]
﻿
When you open your inventory while your line is cast, time will continue to pass as normal. If a fish bites, the menu will automatically close so you never miss a catch. It's perfect companion for players who use auto-fishing mods or just want to make the most of every minute in the day.

This mod uses a stable, non-invasive "ghost menu" technique, so it's highly compatible with other mods, including time-scalers like ItsStardewTime/TimeMaster.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Open your inventory, map, skills, and crafting tabs while fishing.
[*]Keeps the game clock running so time passes naturally.
[*]Automatically closes the menu when a fish bites (configurable).
[*]Option to have the inventory unfreeze time always or just while fishing.
[*]KB support. [b]Gamepad support coming soon.[/b]
[/list][b]Installation
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].

[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].

[*]Download and extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.

[/list][b]Configuration
[/b]You can edit the settings in-game if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed.

[list]
[*][b]Unfreeze Time Always:[/b] If true, the inventory menu will never pause the game, even when you're not fishing. Default is false.
[*][b]Unfreeze Time While Fishing:[/b] If true, the inventory menu will only unfreeze time when you are actively fishing. Default is true.
[*][b]Close On Fish Bite:[/b] If true, the menu will automatically close when a fish bites. Default is true.
[/list][b]Compatibility [/b]

[list]
[*]Built for 1.6
[*]Doesn't affect time controlling mods.
[*]Tested with 140+ mods.
[/list][b]See Also

[/b][url=https://github.com/jevonlipsey/stardew-inventory-while-fishing]Source code[/url]
